Design direction is ready for submission.

A simplified simulation of FreelanceChain's milestone flow. Sample data only; nothing is submitted or stored.

01 / CONTEXT

The idea.

An ongoing solo project exploring accountability in freelance collaboration. Clients create projects and review applications; freelancers submit proposals and milestone work through dedicated workflows.

02 / ENGINEERING

The design problem.

Keeping project ownership and milestone actions consistent across two different roles.

The API derives project ownership from the authenticated user, checks client and freelancer permissions, and allows submitted milestones to be approved before activating the next step.

03 / IMPLEMENTATION

Inside the project.

  • Client and freelancer authentication flows
  • Project creation with budget and milestone validation
  • Project applications, acceptance and rejection
  • Milestone submission and client approval

The Trust Score is part of the product vision described in the README. It is not presented here as a verified completed feature. This project is still evolving.
